Blue Elephant Theatre Announcement

We have now surrendered our theatre building but continue to work to offer participation opportunities, including workshops for early years on Mondays and Tuesdays. You can read more about our plans for the future here.

Amanda Vilanova has written a beautiful piece about the impact of the theatre building here for Writers Mosaic.

Much of our website is now out of date and we will be replacing it as soon as possible.

Please note that our new registered address is 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London W1W 5PF

Community arts

Playing Up! at Elephant & Castle (Tuesdays)

 

Dates
Tuesday 3 March - Tuesday 30 June
Times
10:00 am, 11:30 am
Days of the week
Tuesday

An exciting opportunity for early years children and their parents/carers who live, work or study in the Elephant & Castle Opportunity Area!

We have Playing Up! workshops just for you!

These entirely free creative play workshops will run on Tuesdays at the Elephant & Castle Community Hub from Tuesday March 3rd.

Join us to act out a story with your little ones and connect with other parents and caregivers.

The session times are:

10am - 11am - Toddlers/preschoolers (approx 15 months/walking - 4 years)
11.30am - 12.30pm - Babies (age 0 - approx 15 months/walking)
(You're welcome to try both groups to see which seems more appropriate)

"A really magical experience for both of us!" (parent feedback on a favourite workshop)

One of our facilitators is a Spanish-speaker and will translate for any families who would benefit.

Please complete our registration form here to sign up.

These workshops are funded by the Elephant & Castle Fund and aim to reach people living in the Elephant & Castle Opportunity area, which includes a lot of SE17 postcodes. A map of where it covers can be seen here here

Many thanks to the Elephant & Castle Community Hub for providing space for the project. The hub can be found at Castle Square, 2nd floor, 40 Elephant Rd, London SE17 1EU. There is a lift for buggies.

Young People's Theatre

 

Dates
Wednesday 15 April - Wednesday 17 June
Times
4:30 pm, 6:00 pm
Days of the week
Wednesday

Blue Elephant Theatre's Young People's Theatre has restarted!

There will be free drama workshops on Wednesdays from April 15th, run by Montel and Jo, at Bethwin Road Adventure Playground, 4 Bethwin Rd, London SE5 0YF.

Workshops are at these times:
4.30pm - 5.30pm - ages 7 - 11 (please note that this workshop takes place amongst the playground's other activities and may not be suitable for children who find busy situations difficult. If you are concerned, please get in touch and we can arrange a conversation before your child starts.)
6pm - 7.30pm - ages 11 - 18

Please complete our registration form here to sign up a child or young person.

This project is funded by United St Saviour's Charity, Newcomen Collett Foundation and Southwark Neighbourhoods Fund.
